source.title: Liebherr Technical data - Mobile crane LTM 1040-2.1 [m/t] (liebherr-196-ltm-1040-2-1-td-196-02-defisr03-2023, linked from liebherr.com product page)

notes: Values from the official Liebherr metric datasheet (p.9: 360°, 6.5 t). 10.5 m boom has an over-rear '*' sub-column (40 t at 2.5 m = headline rating; 35.4 t at 3 m) which is NOT stored, and the 2.5 m radius row exists only in that column (so dropped); other boom lengths have a '**' telescopable-load sub-column, also not stored. Outrigger span not printed on the table (icon only); full span from the dimension drawing (VarioBase transverse 2.328-6.028 m). Max supporting force 310 kN (32 t), p.7. Operating weight not stated: on-road ≤ 24 t (2 x 12 t) with 1.5 t counterweight. maxHookHeight not taken (graph only, p.8). Overall length incl. superstructure overhang 10.930 m; tail radius R = 3330 mm (top view). Dims from the side/top dimension drawing: overallLength_m = carrier length (bottom dimension chain, carrier front to rear); axle positions and slew centre are cumulative sums of that chain, measured from the carrier front. Height/width = columns A/B-or-C of the dimension table for the standard 385/95 R 25 (14.00 R 25) tyres. wheelDiameter_m is NOT from the drawing: nominal value computed from the tyre designation (25 in rim + 2 x 95% x 385 mm = 1.37 m). Boom pivot height/offset are not dimensioned on the drawing (null). Liebherr remarks: hook block weight is part of the load (chartIncludesHookBlock true). Dimension reference corrected: the datasheet's bottom dimension chain starts at the front of the boom head (transport position, boom overhanging the cab), not at the carrier front bumper. overallLength_m is now the carrier length (front bumper to rear) and axlePositions_m / slewCentreFromFront_m are measured from the carrier front bumper; the boom head overhang ahead of the bumper is stored as boomOverhangFront_m = 2.071 m (overall transport length incl. boom = 10.605 m). Evidence (dimensions drawing p.3): bottom chain 2071 | 2886 | 3580 | 2068 = 10605 with separate 8534 carrier dimension; slew centre 2650 behind 1st axle.
